```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA will engage in one unified national campaign, Drop Student Debt.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Education is a basic need that should be guaranteed by the government, not a financial instrument with which to generate surplus value.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Drop Student Debt campaign demands government lowering of the debt burden facing most college graduates and their parents in the short term.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Drop Student Debt campaign advances the transformative demand for publicly financed, free higher education and equivalent technical training as a universal right.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The student debt bubble endangers our future economic well-being.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Drop Student Debt campaign enables DSA locals and YDS chapters to talk politics with younger members of our communities through tabling and petitioning.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA calls upon President Barack Obama to issue an executive order to expand his administration’s income-based 10-year payment plan for retiring student debt.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA seeks to amend the current Income Based Repayment Plan to allow all borrowers to have the remainder of their student debt forgiven after 10 years.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Currently, borrowers who work in the public sector or for a 501c3 for 10 years have their debts forgiven after 10 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
